entries.subject: Orbit
entries.finding: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table: P 6.20401 d (Kunimoto et al. 2025); a/R* derived from its semi-major axis 0.0573 au and stellar radius 0.63 solar radii (Kunimoto et al. 2025); inclination 87.93 degrees (Kunimoto et al. 2025); no archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular; transit mid-time 2460017.114 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB (Kunimoto et al. 2025). Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
